<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->
# Independent PR1 source-scope review

The exact three-source PR1 scope qualifies at upstream revision
`f29b0afe7ad253cc0562bc8dfdd48fc1acec710e`. No correctness blocker was found for
the admitted iterator refusal repair. The inherited comparator exception defect
remains exposed by its unchanged standalone witness.

## Received scope and custody

The detached worktree `M3jdk21-pr1-review` was created successfully from cached
public Git objects. Its complete source change set is:

| SDK pass | Receiving owner | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `readonly-iterator` | `m3/collections/src/main/java/com/m3/collections/M3FilteredLists.java` | The existing production file receives a 13-line forwarding iterator guard. |
| `wrapper-contract-v2` | `m3/collections/src/test/java/com/m3/collections/M3WrapperConvergenceContract.java` | The qualified 384-line frozen standalone contract is added. |
| `wrapper-junit-v2` | `m3/collections/src/test/java/com/m3/collections/M3WrapperConvergenceTest.java` | The qualified 13-line JUnit entrypoint is added. |

`EXACT_SOURCE_CHANGES.tsv` records the complete preimage/ABSENT and actual SDK
postimage hashes. Each patch was applied serially using `git apply --check` and
`git apply` on the actual retained SDK patch, after all three starting conditions
had been admitted. The helper's existing path-containment, receipt parser, hash,
and test-set definitions were reused. The evidence adapter only resolves the
documented current host layout; it does not transform Java or implement a new
rewrite engine.

The prior actual SDK suite reports contain five successful host tests for each
pass. This review revalidated their exact report/patch/result hashes, complete
bound inputs (316, 338, and 345 per pass), canonical engine Git blobs and SHA-256
pins, and retained refusal diagnostics. These counts overlap between passes.
The host suites were reused as qualified evidence; this independent review ran
the receiving product gates. No SDK input drift was observed.

## Contract decision

The original factory documentation at `M3FilteredLists.java:54–55` declares that
the view explicitly refuses all mutation methods. The existing private owner's
comment at lines 128–130 requires refusal even for empty/no-op calls. The frozen
f29 baseline witness nevertheless reports `IllegalStateException` for ordinary
iterator removal before the first `next()` call. Unconditional
`UnsupportedOperationException` is therefore an explicit defect repair against
the declared read-only policy; it is a deliberate change to that baseline
mutator failure, not a claim of identical baseline exception behavior.

The guard obtains the original `super.iterator()` and directly forwards
`hasNext`, `next`, and `forEachRemaining`. Its `remove` method alone enforces the
read-only boundary. Runtime comparison against the frozen inherited read path
covers array and linked owners, predicate call sequences and demand, null action
refusal, the same predicate-owned exception object, and retry behavior. The
change does not claim to repair the existing quadratic predicate demand or the
ordinary cursor's missing backing fail-fast detection. It adds a small cursor
wrapper allocation, with no performance improvement claim.

## Actual receiving product gates

The order is recorded in separate immutable command and result receipts:

| Gate | Actual result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Owning-module lint | Passed `git diff --check`; whitespace of both absent-to-present test owners also checked. | `06-lint.json` |
| Strict Java 21 compilation | Passed offline Maven `test-compile`; 133 production and 158 test source files compiled with the module's existing `-Xlint:all,-module` and `-Werror` settings. | `07-compile.json`, raw Maven logs |
| Complete owning-module JUnit suite | **232 tests, 78 suites, zero failures, errors, or skips.** This exactly matches the 231-test/77-suite f29 baseline plus one wrapper test. | `08-junit.json`, `08-junit-suites.json`, `junit-reports/` |
| Actual standalone `readonly-policy` | Passed **25 checks**. | `09-readonly-policy.json`, raw Java logs |
| Actual standalone `readonly-effects` | Passed **8 checks**. These are a repeated subset of the policy checks, not eight additional distinct cases. | `10-readonly-effects.json`, raw Java logs |
| Public/protected API comparison | `javap -protected -s` output for `com.m3.collections.M3FilteredLists` is byte-identical to the frozen f29 baseline. Signature-output SHA-256: `501a138684ef77a5590ed2b691e2b16d67dbadb3e82aacdcc1b6d74c8b454477`. | `11-api.json`, before/after raw output |
| Preserved standalone `comparator-failure` | **Exit 1 retained**, with `read-only map comparator failure: missing IllegalArgumentException`. The first map assertion fails; the mutable-set assertion is not reached. | `12-comparator-failure.json`, raw stderr |

The actual JUnit process uses the cached `m3-source-1` JUnit, API Guardian, and
OpenTest4J artifacts. Their observed classpath and file hashes are retained in
`JUNIT_RUNTIME_CLASSPATH.json`. The scoped Java/Maven environment is copied from
the existing toolchain command evidence; each command receipt includes that
source and its digest. Maven did not resolve artifacts from the network.

## Review limits and final state

The final manifest contains exactly one production modification and two added
test owners. Every other owning-module source input retains its initial hash and
mode, the worktree remains detached at f29, and all three admitted files retain
their actual SDK postimages after every gate. This qualification contains no
index or JNI candidate. Documentation additions are outside this isolated source
qualification and are reviewed separately by the parent task.

The v2 JUnit entrypoint selects the narrowly admitted `readonly-policy` mode. All
original standalone modes, including the default compound `readonly` mode and
the comparator assertions, remain present. The passing suite consequently
establishes this explicit policy repair and its tested read effects; it does not
establish full wrapper correctness or resolve the independently recorded
comparator, interior-null, traversal-complexity, or fail-fast findings.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hitesh Soliwal and Contributors to the Synexia Project
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Retain serial module-gate evidence for the exact received PR1 source scope."""

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import receive_sdk_pr1 as receive

BASE = receive.BASE
TARGET = receive.TARGET
EVIDENCE = receive.EVIDENCE
MODULE = TARGET / 'm3/collections'
JDK = BASE / 'toolchain/jdk-21.0.12.1+1'
ENV_SOURCE = BASE / 'work-m3-wrappers-20261018/recipe-host-evidence/04-compile-text.command.json'
ENV_OVERRIDES = json.loads(ENV_SOURCE.read_text())['environment_overrides']
MAVEN = [str(BASE / 'toolchain/apache-maven-3.10.0/bin/mvn'), '-o', '-B', '-ntp',
         '-s', str(BASE / 'toolchain/m3-settings.xml'), '-f', str(MODULE / 'pom.xml'),
         '-Dmaven.repo.local=' + str(BASE / 'toolchain/m2-repository')]
BASELINE = BASE / 'work-m3-wrappers-20261018/integration-f29/baseline-target'
GATES = ('lint', 'compile', 'junit', 'readonly-policy', 'readonly-effects', 'api', 'comparator-failure')


def frozen_sources():
    receive.verify_state(3)
    current = receive.inventory()
    expected = json.loads((EVIDENCE / '05-wrapper-junit-v2-source-state.json').read_text())
    if current != expected:
        raise ValueError('owning-module source inputs changed after reception')
    return current


def command(label, argv, expected_exit=0):
    metadata = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(TARGET), 'environment_overrides': ENV_OVERRIDES,
                'environment_source': str(ENV_SOURCE), 'environment_source_sha256': receive.sha(ENV_SOURCE),
                'expected_exit': expected_exit, 'utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    receive.write_json(label + '.command.json', metadata)
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment.update(ENV_OVERRIDES)
    start = time.monotonic()
    with (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')).open('xb') as stdout, \
            (EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log')).open('xb') as stderr:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=TARGET, env=environment, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
    metadata.update({'exit': result.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start,
                     'expected_exit_observed': result.returncode == expected_exit,
                     'stdout_sha256': receive.sha(EVIDENCE / (label + '.stdout.log')),
                     'stderr_sha256': receive.sha(EVIDENCE / (label + '.stderr.log'))})
    receive.write_json(label + '.receipt.json', metadata)
    if result.returncode != expected_exit:
        raise ValueError('unexpected command exit: ' + label)
    return metadata


def suites(root):
    result = []
    for path in sorted(root.glob('TEST-*.xml')):
        suite = ET.parse(path).getroot()
        result.append({'name': suite.attrib['name'], **{
            key: int(suite.attrib[key]) for key in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')},
            'report': str(path), 'sha256': receive.sha(path)})
    if not result or len({item['name'] for item in result}) != len(result):
        raise ValueError('empty or duplicate JUnit suite evidence')
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('gate', choices=GATES)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    index = GATES.index(args.gate)
    if index:
        predecessor = EVIDENCE / (f'{index + 5:02d}-' + GATES[index - 1] + '.json')
        prior = json.loads(predecessor.read_text())
        if not prior['gate_satisfied']:
            raise ValueError('previous serial gate not satisfied')
    frozen_sources()
    name = f'{index + 6:02d}-' + args.gate
    result = {'stage': args.gate, 'revision': receive.REVISION, 'exact_source_changes': 3,
              'utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    if args.gate == 'lint':
        result['command'] = command(name + '-diff', ['git', 'diff', '--check', '--', 'm3/collections'])
        for row in receive.PASSES:
            source = (TARGET / row[1]).read_text()
            if not source.endswith('\n') or any(line != line.rstrip() for line in source.splitlines()):
                raise ValueError('changed-source whitespace: ' + row[1])
        result['untracked_test_whitespace_checked'] = [row[1] for row in receive.PASSES[1:]]
    elif args.gate == 'compile':
        result['command'] = command(name + '-maven', MAVEN + ['test-compile'])
        result['strict_settings'] = {'release': 21, 'compiler_arguments': ['-Xlint:all,-module', '-Werror']}
        result['pom_sha256'] = receive.sha(MODULE / 'pom.xml')
    elif args.gate == 'junit':
        result['command'] = command(name + '-maven', MAVEN + ['surefire:test'])
        actual = suites(MODULE / 'target/surefire-reports')
        baseline = suites(BASELINE / 'surefire-reports')
        totals = {key: sum(row[key] for row in actual) for key in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}
        if any(totals[key] for key in ('failures', 'errors', 'skipped')):
            raise ValueError('JUnit failure, error, or skipped test')
        upstream = {row['name']: row['tests'] for row in baseline}
        expected = dict(upstream)
        expected['com.m3.collections.M3WrapperConvergenceTest'] = 1
        if {row['name']: row['tests'] for row in actual} != expected:
            raise ValueError('JUnit suite differs from upstream plus one wrapper test')
        receive.write_json(name + '-suites.json', actual)
        result.update({'totals': totals, 'suites': len(actual),
                       'baseline_tests': sum(upstream.values()), 'baseline_suites': len(baseline),
                       'suite_increment': {'com.m3.collections.M3WrapperConvergenceTest': 1}})
    elif args.gate == 'api':
        owner = 'com.m3.collections.M3FilteredLists'
        before = command(name + '-before', [str(JDK / 'bin/javap'), '-protected', '-s',
                         '-classpath', str(BASELINE / 'classes'), owner])
        after = command(name + '-after', [str(JDK / 'bin/javap'), '-protected', '-s',
                        '-classpath', str(MODULE / 'target/classes'), owner])
        if before['stdout_sha256'] != after['stdout_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('public/protected owner API changed')
        result.update({'commands': [before, after], 'owner': owner,
                       'protected_public_signatures_identical': True,
                       'signature_sha256': after['stdout_sha256'],
                       'baseline_owner_class_sha256': receive.sha(BASELINE / 'classes/com/m3/collections/M3FilteredLists.class'),
                       'candidate_owner_class_sha256': receive.sha(MODULE / 'target/classes/com/m3/collections/M3FilteredLists.class')})
    else:
        runtime_cp = os.pathsep.join(str(MODULE / p) for p in ('target/test-classes', 'target/classes'))
        argv = [str(JDK / 'bin/java'), '-XX:-UsePerfData', '-cp', runtime_cp,
                'com.m3.collections.M3WrapperConvergenceContract', args.gate]
        failed_witness = args.gate == 'comparator-failure'
        result['command'] = command(name + '-java', argv, 1 if failed_witness else 0)
        stdout = (EVIDENCE / (name + '-java.stdout.log')).read_text()
        stderr = (EVIDENCE / (name + '-java.stderr.log')).read_text()
        if failed_witness:
            marker = 'java.lang.AssertionError: read-only map comparator failure: missing IllegalArgumentException'
            if marker not in stderr or 'PASS M3WrapperConvergenceContract' in stdout:
                raise ValueError('inherited comparator failure changed')
            result.update({'observed_behavior': 'INHERITED_FAILURE_RETAINED', 'expected_assertion': marker,
                           'comparator_contract_passed': False,
                           'scope': 'first read-only map assertion fails; mutable-set assertion not reached'})
        else:
            expected = 'PASS M3WrapperConvergenceContract mode=' + args.gate + ' checks='
            if not stdout.strip().startswith(expected) or stderr:
                raise ValueError('focused runtime evidence changed')
            result['checks'] = int(stdout.strip().removeprefix(expected))
    frozen_sources()
    result.update({'gate_satisfied': True, 'owning_module_source_drift': False,
                   'completed_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
    receive.write_json(name + '.json', result)
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items()
                      if key not in ('command', 'commands')}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
